name: Certificate Management Response 3
definition: Information related to the result of the certificate management request.

POIIdentification.name: POI Identification
POIIdentification.definition: Identification of the terminal or system using the certificate management service.

TMIdentification.name: TM Identification
TMIdentification.definition: Identification of the TM or the MTM providing the Certificate Authority service.

Result.name: Result
Result.definition: Outcome of the certificate service processing.

SecurityProfile.name: Security Profile
SecurityProfile.definition: Identification of the security profile, for creation, renewal or revocation of certificate.

POIChallengeValue.name: POI Challenge Value
POIChallengeValue.definition: Challenge value sends by the POI to be received back in a message response.

TMSDateTime.name: TMS Date Time
TMSDateTime.definition: Date and Time of the TMS.

ClientCertificate.name: Client Certificate
ClientCertificate.definition: Created or renewed certificate. The certificate is ASN.1/DER encoded.

ClientCertificatePath.name: Client Certificate Path
ClientCertificatePath.definition: Certificate of the client certificate path, from the CA (Certificate Authority) certificate, to the root certificate, for renewal or revocation of certificate.

ServerCertificatePath.name: Server Certificate Path
ServerCertificatePath.definition: Certificate of the server certificate path, from the CA (Certificate Authority) certificate, to the root certificate, for renewal or revocation of certificate.
